improvement_detail: wins only for t much larger than L; the O(L^2) product step dominates for moderate t
statement: The exponent-arithmetic fast-forward (Theorem 3) is exact; at L = 1024 it is 62-100x faster than direct simulation at t = 10^5 but 0.5-0.9x (slower) around t = 10^3 for L >= 1024, and equal for t < 2L (where it falls back to simulation).
title: Commutative-semigroup fast-forward by exponent arithmetic
